## Problem
`candidates.mjs` (#1394) says "candidates for a free slot from SV, by priority", but the first run listed P3, P3, P4, P2, P3… in ticket-key order: SV-331 (P3) and SV-419 (P4) came before SV-532 (P2) and SV-1710 (P2). Unassigned P2 Bugs created in the last weeks (for example SV-4574, SV-4449) were not among the 15 checked at all. Most of those listed were decisions or infrastructure work (rotate a licence key, promote WAF rules, decide a policy), not self-contained work a worker can finish, so all 15 came back flagged and none was usable.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC1: Given unassigned tickets across priority tiers, when candidates are listed, then they are ordered by the §4 Priority field (P1 first), then by newest, and the first CHECK_MAX checked are the highest-priority ones.
- AC2: Given a ticket whose summary or labels mark it as a decision, or as an access, key or infrastructure change outside the repo, when candidates are listed, then it is left out with its reason, like a blocked ticket.
- AC3: Given Bugs and Tasks at the same priority, when candidates are listed, then Bugs come first.

## Design
No UI.

## Out of scope
None.

## Verification
With unassigned P2 and P4 tickets in the project, the P2s are checked and listed before any P4, and a "Decide whether…" Task is listed under left out.
